Ward Perry (born March 20, 1970) is a Canadian voice actor and ADR script writer who has voiced characters for several anime dubbed in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. He is mostly known as the voice actor of Dragon Ball Z villain Dr. Wheelo, Rowen of the Strata in Ronin Warriors, Geese Howard in the Fatal Fury animations, Scavenger in Transformers: Armada, and the first voice of Landmine in Transformers: Energon. He retired in 2009 and has not made any new appearances on television since.
